getProperty.description: Returns the value of a property or variable inside PlayState, a saved variable, or a Lua Sprite/Text.

setProperty.description: Sets the value of a property or variable inside PlayState. Returns the value.

parameters.allowMaps: Allows setting map-type values. Defaults to false.
parameters.allowInstances: Allows setting custom instances. Defaults to false.

getPropertyFromGroup.description: Returns the value of a property of a member inside a FlxTypedGroup/FlxSpriteGroup.

parameters.index: Index of the member in the group.
parameters.allowMaps: Allows getting map-type values. Defaults to false.

examples: Gets the current animation name of the 2nd player strum.

setPropertyFromGroup.description: Sets the value of a property of a member inside a FlxTypedGroup/FlxSpriteGroup.

parameters.index: Index of the member in the group.

getPropertyFromClass.description: Returns the value of a property inside a class.

parameters.allowMaps: Allows getting map values. Defaults to false.

examples: Gets the downScroll preference from ClientPrefs.

setPropertyFromClass.description: Sets the value of a property inside a class.

callMethod.description: Calls a method from PlayState or a Lua Sprite/Text.

parameters.args: Optional arguments to pass to the method.

callMethodFromClass.description: Calls a method from a class.

parameters.args: Optional arguments to pass to the method.

createInstance.description: Creates a new instance of a class.

updateHitbox.description: Updates the hitbox of a sprite to match its graphic.
